text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. The purpose of this report is to prohibit parking on the north side of Ripley Avenue, between South Kingsway and a point 63 metres east. Residents brought a petition to the Councillor's office to prohibit parking in this area, as their section of the roadway is too narrow, especially in winter, with parking on both sides of the street.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Prohibited parking at all times on the north side of Ripley Avenue, from South Kingsway to a point 63 metres east.
